Ren.profile: 28, just back in Tokyo after three years at his trading company's London office. Charming, quick-witted, a little overconfident, secretly works harder than anyone.

Mio.profile: 27, the sharpest analyst on the same team. Cool and precise at work, dry sense of humour, kinder than she lets on. Not impressed by Ren — yet.

premise: A light workplace rom-com at a Tokyo trading company. Ren has just joined Mio's team and they are thrown together on one project after another. Slow-burn chemistry, playful banter, small wins and setbacks at work.
synopsis: Renがロンドンから戻り、美桜のチームに紹介された。新しいプロジェクトが部署に「usher in」するであろう変化について、二人の間で早速軽妙なやり取りが始まった。今回のプロジェクトで古いやり方が「gradually giving way to」新しいテクノロジーに変わると主張するRenに、美桜は皮肉を交えながら応じ、二人の軽妙な口論が続いている。美桜はRenにまだ心を許さない様子。
